title: Generating from the retrieved sources and citing them

videos.script: Three sources go into the prompt, numbered, each with its section and its date. The question comes last. {{prompt}} The reply comes back with numbers in it. The program turns each number into a link a person can follow. {{cite}} But a citation is a claim, and claims can be wrong. Watch a checker catch a true sentence cited to the wrong source, and a sentence no source says. {{check}} Then watch every check pass on a reply that does not answer the question at all. {{relevance}} Next, the instruction to say when the sources are silent. Send it with no sources, and out comes a phone number that does not exist. {{phone}} So the code refuses before the model is ever asked. {{refuse}} Two sources that disagree get the same treatment. Wherever the rule can be written down, it goes in code. {{conflict}} And for answers that bind, the clause number goes back into the citation. {{end}}
